title: 第11章 伊格尔斯的挑衅第12章 势均力敌的对抗
content_zh:
第011章 伊格尔斯的挑衅
伊斯兰克球场上，有着将近两万人，但现在却静默一片，几乎所有人的目光全部集中在绿荫场上那个黑发球员身上。
几秒钟后，主裁判才反应过来，打了个进球有效的手势，并吹响了哨音。
这时其他人也反应过来，顿时哗然一片，观众席上的球迷们都在相互谈论着刚才看到的炫耀的景象。
“Goal！！！球进了，但刚才我们看到了什么，那个黑头发的小子，是那个小子，对了...是艾伦.王，是艾伦，他居然在足球上为大家跳了一曲美丽的华尔兹！这太不可思议了，到现在我仍然不敢相信刚才看到的一幕！！！这真是无法形容。”
解说员嗓子好像喊得有些沙哑，他喝了口水，继续说道：“那么我们来看看慢镜头回放......停下，哦，就是这里，大家看看，他这个动作，真是太有想象力了，这样不会掉下来吗？这简直就是奇迹，是的，奇迹，朋友们，伊斯兰克球场今天上演了一部美丽的歌舞剧，这不是一场足球比赛，这是舞蹈比赛，是......真不知道我们的伍德盖特先生是在哪里找到这么一个舞蹈家来加入球队的！”
现场解说员都有些语无伦次了，刚才那一幕实在太惊人了，那种动作真的是人类能够做出来的吗？
伍尔弗汉普顿的教练席上也是欢呼一片，老伍德站起来和几个替补队员相互的抱了抱，表示祝贺。他心里很是畅快，艾伦可是自己一力争取才进入狼队的球员，他现在就能崭露头角，自己也很高兴。
曼联青年队的教练席，主教练保罗－麦克吉尼斯微咪着双眼看着场上低下头缓缓向后场跑去的黑发小子，心里却打起了主意：如果这个小子全场发挥都这么出色的话，把他带到曼联应该是个不错的选择。至于皮特？那只是玩笑而已，那种普普通通的前锋，曼联青年队根本不会有他的位置。
他一点也不为刚才那个进球懊恼，那只是一个意外而已，不是吗？
“让我们预祝这个黑发小子能在伊斯兰克球场取得成功吧，我想戴夫先生应该来看看这场比赛的录像，考虑下掉他去一线队，或许会是一个不错的补充，要知道现在狼队的成绩实在不怎么样，……”广播里，解说员仍然在喋喋不休…
王利现在却没有心情去听广播里的赞扬，他正在为刚才的大胆而懊恼，如果那个曼联球员在他踩球的时候轻轻撞他一下，这次肯定会以失败告终的，他的身体可禁不住冲撞呢。
后怕之后，他又有些庆幸刚才的成功，不过他心里却暗下决定，在内力修为有所成就以前，绝不能在使用那么花哨的动作了，虽然这确实很能吸引观众…
现场球迷显然不会去想这些事情，他们只知道场上那个黑发的东方小子绝对是个名不见转的玩球高手，他们在为伍尔弗汉普顿能有这样一名球员而高兴，也在为现在能够领先曼联队而欢呼！
最可怜的要属哈利尔森了，是他进的球，可是满场的球迷却没有任何一个人在喊他的名字，也没有任何队友过来祝贺他......
开场能够进球，这对伍尔弗汉普顿青年队来说确实是很不错的开局，而且刚才王利的表演也极大的提高了士气，所以现在狼队青年队有了足够的信心，他们坚信这场比赛的获胜者一定会是他们。
不过，对曼联青年队来说，刚才的那次进球虽然有些意外，但他们并没有气馁。
要知道，在往届的英格兰青年足总杯上，曼联青年队可是拿过六次冠军的超级强队。无论从俱乐部历史上，还是现今实力上，曼联青年队都没有任何理由会输。
即使是伍尔弗汉普顿有一名盘带大师级人物，但足球可是十一个人的比赛，一个人在强在团队的压迫下也是毫无办法的。
所以他们彼此看了看，都坚定了反击的决心，他们要靠真正的实力来压倒对手，找回比分，也只是差一球而已，比赛才刚刚开始，谁胜谁负还未可知。

重新开球后，曼联队就开始了他们的冲击。他们的进攻打的有声有色，一波一波的攻击络绎不决。
伍尔弗汉普顿青年队也只能龟缩在己方半场，承受着对方进攻的浪潮。老伍德对此也毫无办法，无论从战术、配合又或是球员的实力来说，两队的差距实在太大了。
他也只能寄希望于自己的队员们能够顶住这几十分钟了，只要时间一过，曼联的士气就会受到影响，那么他们反击的机会就到了。
王利也一直在后防线附近游走，曼联的球员很少粘球，娴熟的短传配合使得他也没有什么好办法，这样被动的比赛实在有些令人厌烦。
不过，当他得到球以后，就径直的往前带球，每次他那华丽的身影都能赢得全场球迷的欢呼声。
当然他冲过中场时，有机会便会长传到对方禁区，这也对曼联队造成了很大的威胁，在二十多分钟内，他已经完成了五次长传，每次都吓的曼联门将一身冷汗。
第三十一分钟，曼联边锋查德维克带球突进禁区，经过几脚传递后，球就交到了“小鹰”伊格尔斯脚下，这时，他附近只有一个狼队的后卫。
这么来之不易的机会他显然不会放过，左脚一勾，球便被颠起，右脚直接抽打在皮球上，球径直朝着伍尔弗汉普顿的球门飞去。
虽然托姆.史密斯已经尽力去扑球了，但他却有些力所不及。
“呀！危险，是伊格尔斯，球进了…哎，托姆站的有些靠后了，这留给了伊格尔斯射门的空间，这次失误了，曼联扳平了比分。”解说员显然是一个重视的狼队球迷，对曼联的进球他解说的有气无力的。
伊格尔斯缓缓跑回了曼联的半场，与王利擦身而过时，嘲讽般的小声说了一句：“小子，曼联可不是你那种花俏的足球能够打败的，好好学学吧。”
王利无所谓的耸了耸肩，摊开双手，这算是挑衅吗？
不过，他的脸色却变得凝重起来，既然是挑衅，那我便应战吧。;
content_en:
Chapter 011 Eagles’ Provocation
There were nearly 20,000 people on the Islamic Stadium, but now there was silence. Almost everyone's eyes were focused on the black-haired player on the green field.
After a few seconds, the referee reacted, made a sign that the goal was valid, and blew the whistle.
At this time, others also reacted, and there was an uproar. The fans in the audience were all talking to each other about the show off they had just seen.
"Goal!!! The ball was scored, but what did we see just now? That black-haired kid, that kid, by the way...it's Allen Wang, it's Allen, he actually danced a beautiful waltz on the football for everyone! This is incredible, I still can't believe what I just saw!!! It's really indescribable."
The commentator's voice seemed to be hoarse from shouting. He took a sip of water and continued: "Then let's take a look at the slow-motion replay... Stop, oh, right here, everyone, look at this action. He is so imaginative. Will it not fall off? This is simply bizarre. Miracle, yes, miracle, friends, a beautiful musical was staged at the Islamic Stadium today. This is not a football match, this is a dance competition, it is... I really don’t know where our Mr. Woodgate found such a dancer to join the team!”
The commentators on the scene were a little incoherent. The scene just now was so amazing. Is that kind of action really possible for humans?
The Wolverhampton coaching bench also cheered. Old Wood stood up and hugged each other with several substitutes to express congratulations. He was very happy in his heart. Allen was a player that he fought hard to enter the Wolves. Now he can stand out, and he is very happy.
In the coaching bench of the Manchester United youth team, head coach Paul McGuinness looked at the black-haired kid with his head lowered on the field and slowly ran to the backcourt with slightly squinting eyes, but he had an idea in his mind: If this kid performs so well throughout the game, bringing him to Manchester United should be a good choice. As for Pete? That's just a joke. There is no place for that kind of ordinary striker in the Manchester United youth team.
He wasn't upset at all about the goal just now. It was just an accident, wasn't it?
"Let us wish this black-haired boy success at the Islamic Stadium. I think Mr. Dave should come and watch the video of this game and consider dropping him to the first team. It may be a good addition. You must know that the current performance of the Wolves is really not very good..." On the radio, the commentator was still chattering...
Wang Li was not in the mood to listen to the praise on the radio now. He was annoyed by his boldness just now. If the Manchester United player bumped him lightly when he was stepping on the ball, this time it would definitely end in failure. His body couldn't help the collision.
After being frightened, he was a little grateful for his success, but he secretly decided that before he had achieved some achievements in internal strength cultivation, he would never use such fancy movements again, although it was indeed very attractive to the audience...
The fans at the scene obviously don't think about these things. They only know that the black-haired oriental boy on the field is definitely a little-known master of playing football. They are happy that Wolverhampton can have such a player, and they are also cheering for being able to lead Manchester United now!
The most pitiful one is Harrelson. He scored the goal, but no one in the crowd of fans shouted his name, and no teammates came to congratulate him...
Being able to score a goal at the beginning is indeed a very good start for the Wolverhampton youth team, and Wang Li's performance just now also greatly improved morale, so now the Wolves youth team has enough confidence, and they firmly believe that the winner of this game will bethem.
However, for the Manchester United youth team, although the goal just now was a bit unexpected, they were not discouraged.
You know, in the previous FA Youth Cup in England, the Manchester United youth team was a super team that had won six championships. Regardless of the club's history or current strength, there is no reason why the Manchester United youth team should lose.
Even though Wolverhampton has a dribbling master, football is a game of eleven people, and there is nothing a person can do under the pressure of a strong team.
So they looked at each other, and they were determined to fight back. They had to rely on their true strength to overwhelm their opponents and regain the score. They were only one goal away. The game had just begun, and it was still unclear who would win and who would lose.
After the restart, Manchester United began their attack. Their offense was vigorous, with waves of attacks coming in waves.
The Wolverhampton youth team could only huddle in its own half and bear the wave of the opponent's attack. Old Wood had nothing to do about it. No matter in terms of tactics, coordination or player strength, the gap between the two teams was really too big.
He can only hope that his players can withstand these dozens of minutes. As soon as time passes, Manchester United's morale will be affected, and then their chance to counterattack will be here.
Wang Li has also been wandering around the back line. Manchester United players rarely stick to the ball, and his skillful short passing cooperation makes him have no good methods. Such a passive game is really annoying.
However, when he gets the ball, he dribbles straight forward, and his gorgeous figure can win cheers from the fans every time.
Of course, when he rushes through the midfield, he will pass long passes into the opponent's penalty area when he has the opportunity. This also poses a great threat to Manchester United. In more than 20 minutes, he has completed five long passes, scaring the Manchester United goalkeeper into a cold sweat every time.
In the 31st minute, Manchester United winger Chadwick dribbled the ball into the penalty area. After a few passes, the ball was handed over to the feet of "Little Eagle" Eagles. At this time, there was only one Wolves defender near him.
He obviously would not let go of such a hard-won opportunity. With a hook of his left foot, the ball was bumped up, and his right foot hit the ball directly. The ball flew straight towards Wolverhampton's goal.
Although Thom Smith tried his best to save the ball, he was somewhat powerless.
"Ah! Danger, it's Eagles, the ball has gone in...Hey, Thom stood a little back, which left room for Eagles to shoot. This time he made a mistake, and Manchester United equalized the score." The commentator was obviously a serious Wolves fan, and he was weak in explaining Manchester United's goal.
Eagles slowly ran back to the Manchester United half. When he passed Wang Li, he whispered mockingly: "Boy, Manchester United is not something you can beat with your fancy football. Learn from it."
Wang Li shrugged indifferently and spread his hands. Is this considered a provocation?
However, his expression became serious. Since it is a provocation, I will accept it. ;
